# The Lantern Keeper

Mara was learning to work at Greyhaven lighthouse. One stormy evening, Ivo hurt his ankle, so Mara had to climb the tower alone. The Gull Star was coming toward Black Tooth Reef, and the harbour lantern was still dark.

Magistrate Rusk asked Mara to leave the light off so a rival ship would miss the tide. He warned that he could stop her apprenticeship papers if she refused.

Mara hardly thought about the sailors or the duty Ivo had taught her. What she really wanted was to become famous. She had heard that the harbour council sometimes gave a brass medal to anyone involved in a dramatic rescue, and she imagined everyone cheering her name.

"I'll light it because I want that medal," Mara said.

She carried the spare oil upstairs and lit the lantern. The Gull Star's captain saw the light, corrected course, and passed Black Tooth Reef safely.

Mara reported Rusk's threat afterward. The council removed his authority over apprenticeship papers while it investigated him.

No medal had been promised, but Mara spent the evening hoping the council would decide she deserved one.
